```tla
---------------------------- MODULE Channel ----------------------------
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS Data

VARIABLES chan

TypeInvariant == 
    chan \in [val : Data, rdy : {0, 1}, ack : {0, 1}]

Init == 
    chan \in [val : Data, rdy : {0}, ack : {0}]

Send(d) == 
    /\ chan.rdy = chan.ack
    /\ chan' = [chan EXCEPT !.val = d, !.rdy = 1 - chan.rdy]

Rcv == 
    /\ chan.rdy # chan.ack
    /\ chan' = [chan EXCEPT !.ack = 1 - chan.ack]

Next == 
    \/ \E d \in Data : Send(d)
    \/ Rcv

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_chan

THEOREM Spec => []TypeInvariant

==========================================================================
```
